arithmetic.ordering_exact: dequantise stored moments; add current gradient; form the update from the fp32 sums; quantise after
arithmetic.ordering_reread: quantise after accumulation and dequantise before forming the denominator

gradient_model: per-element scale lognormal(0, sigma) fixed across the run, times a per-step standard-normal direction; parameter fp32 in both arms so the only difference is moment storage
